children: Alstom SA (EURONEXT:ALO) cut its FY2026/27 margin outlook to about 1% from 6.5% and forecast €1.5 billion in negative free cash flow, citing German train project delays and execution issues. It plans to reduce debt by about €2 billion by September 2027 and secured a €2 billion credit line through November 2028.
Previous Week Recap
Margin Outlook Cut, Cash-Flow Hit
: Alstom cut its FY2026/27 margin outlook to about 1% from 6.5% and forecast €1.5 billion in negative free cash flow, citing German train project delays and execution issues.
Debt-Cutting Plan And Credit Line
: Alstom plans to cut debt by about €2 billion by September 2027, including possible asset sales, to protect its investment-grade rating. It secured a €2 billion credit line through November 2028.
SNCF Orders 160 TGV M Trainsets
: Alstom won an SNCF order for 160 TGV M trainsets worth over €5 billion, with deliveries of 15–20 trains yearly. Morocco and French operator Velvet have also bought the model.
Delayed TGV M Enters Service
: Alstom’s double-decker TGV M entered service on SNCF’s Paris–Marseille route in 2026, 2.5 years late. It reaches 320 km/h and is designed to use 20% less energy and carry 20% more passengers.
Recovery And Deleveraging Priorities
: Alstom SA (ALO) identified operational recovery and approximately €2 billion of deleveraging as priorities.
Goldman Sachs Cuts Price Target
: - Goldman Sachs lowered its price target for Alstom SA (ALO) to €9 from €15.50.
AlphaValue Downgrades Alstom
: AlphaValue cut Alstom (ALO) to Reduce from Buy, urging caution until its operational review is complete. Organizational changes may add restructuring or implementation costs.
New TGV Built Across France
: Alstom SA (ALO) and SNCF launched a new-generation TGV, built with input from 11 Alstom factories across France, including sites in La Rochelle, Belfort, Le Creusot and Villeurbanne.
Cairo Monorail Launches First Phase

: Alstom SA (ALO), part of a consortium with Arab Contractors and Orascom Construction, saw Cairo’s monorail launch its first phase: 16 stations linking eastern Cairo to the New Administrative Capital.
Capital Markets Day Planned For 2027
: Alstom SA (ALO) plans to present its long-term strategic and operational plan, along with its medium-term outlook, at a Capital Markets Day in the second quarter of calendar 2027.
